question: Can six static reflection geometry moments remove the second longwave patch sweep without violating existing component, chronological, artifact, memory and equal-work performance gates?
decision: Proceed only with an isolated reflection-only NumPy/Numba experiment. Real-number factorization is valid; float32 execution is not bit-equivalent. No sky-emissivity, vegetation, building or classification factorization in this experiment.

authority.scope: Design artifact only. No main source, documentation, milestone, packaging, or MKL approval changes.

operation_review.unchanged_first_sweep: Retain ordered patch additions to all 14 accumulators, existing solar_gate and pixel sun/shade classifications, and all current dtype promotions.
operation_review.dynamic_reflection: After the first sweep retain the exact nested float32 computation R = float32(float32(float32(float32(accum[0]+Lup)*reflection_factor)*float32(0.5))/float32(pi)). Recompute every pixel every timestep.

factorization.predicate: m[x,p] = (sh[x,p] == 0) or (vs[x,p] == 0) or (vb[x,p] == 0); never replace raw visibility with generic truthiness.
moments: M_dir[x,d] = sum_{p: gate[p,d]} m[x,p] * solid[p] * cosine[p] * directions[p,d], d in E,S,W,N
factorization.proof: R is invariant with respect to p within one completed pixel/timestep. Distributivity over the second sweep gives R times each moment over real numbers. The mask, direction gate and angular factors do not contain forcing. This does not justify reassociation of rounded additions.
factorization.replacement: Set reflection side/down accumulators from R*M_side/down; add R*M_dir once to the unchanged first-sweep cardinal accumulators. Retain original final output addition order and cardinal output mapping E,W,N,S.

immutable_dependencies: Exact three static visibility channels and patch order
Logical tile extent and pixel ordering
Actual steradian argument supplied to define_patch_characteristics, not merely patch_geometry.solid_angle
Patch altitude/azimuth and their exact sine/cosine/cardinal cosine/gates
Numerical profile, moment algorithm version and dtype
forcing_or_state_not_cacheable: Ta, Tgwall, ewall, surface_sun, surface_sh and reflection_factor
Solar altitude/azimuth, solar_gate and sun/shade classification
operation_review.important_limit: The first sweep still decodes and traverses every patch. This experiment removes only the second reflection sweep; it does not eliminate visibility decoding or the main longwave traversal.

rounding_contract.candidate_fixed_before_execution: Build six float64 moments in original patch order from the exact float32 input factors promoted individually to float64; fastmath=False. Evaluate float64(R)*moment, cast once to float32, then float32-add to the original accumulator (including +0 initialized reflection accumulators). No hidden float32/float64 tuning after observing results.

non_equivalence_witness.evidence_class: Locally evaluated operation-order counterexample using original input geometry and an explicitly chosen R; not an upstream output failure.

rounding_contract.fallback: Keep original second sweep executable for unsupported types, nonfinite angular values, nonfinite R or first-sweep accumulators, or unsafe range. A sufficient conservative finite fast-path domain is every |solid|, |sine|, |cosine|, |direction| <= 1, 1<=P<=609, |R| <= FLT_MAX/(16*P), and each initial cardinal |accum| <= FLT_MAX/4. Otherwise fall back, without clipping. Recheck the bound in implementation review. Preserve signed-zero/nonfinite behavior with explicit edge tests; gate failures reject the experiment.
rounding_contract.preserved_gate: Use existing named comparison_v1 rules verbatim; no tolerance relaxation, fixture deletion, masks redefinition, or reference replacement.

ownership_and_cache.phase_one: Explicit immutable MomentBundle passed to isolated kernel; build outside the timed repeated kernel call, but separately measure construction. No global memoization and no source edits outside the isolated experiment snapshot.
ownership_and_cache.phase_two: Only after component success, use an explicitly tile-owned private moment bundle in an isolated pipeline snapshot, released at tile end. GeometryCache is the existing ownership boundary, but currently has no moment member; internal optional plumbing must preserve public signatures and legacy disk schemas. Freeze the small plumbing diff before end-to-end measurement.
ownership_and_cache.key: Bind exact visibility contents, shape/order, actual steradian and angular arrays, algorithm/dtype/profile and source fingerprints. PackedVisibility payloads are immutable; retain references for lifetime safety. Never key mutable dense arrays solely by id. Dense direct calls recompute or make an immutable content-bound copy.
ownership_and_cache.persisted_cache: No new disk cache in the first experiment. Warm geometry on disk does not imply persisted moments. Construct once per fresh measured worker and include cost in both first-use and geometry-warm pipeline timing.
ownership_and_cache.concurrency: Pixel ownership for moment construction and application; deterministic ordered patch reduction within each pixel; distinct serial/parallel cached function identities; no shared patch writes or timestep parallelism.
invalidation_tests: Change one visibility value (including nonbinary values)
Change actual steradian while altitude/azimuth stays fixed
Mutate a dense input between calls
Interleave two tiles and multiple threads

complexity_and_storage.construction: O(N*P) per logical tile per worker; block-decode without constructing a new full N*P dense visibility cube. Bound scratch with execution block size.
complexity_and_storage.application: O(6*N) for reflection per timestep, versus original O(N*P); first sweep remains O(N*P).
complexity_and_storage.persistent_addition_bytes: 48*N (six float64 moments), excluding metadata and bounded scratch.
complexity_and_storage.crossover: Measure construction plus complete 24-step pipeline. Component speedup alone is insufficient; moment storage may reduce admissible concurrent tile count.

worker_packet.objective: Implement and falsify a reflection-only moment variant in an immutable isolated candidate snapshot; retain an unmodified baseline snapshot. No main numerical changes or MKL runtime decision.

component_oracle.dtype_rule: Use existing load_packet type metadata and hash checks; preserve tensor/ndarray/numpy-scalar/Python-scalar distinctions. Preserve recorded original upstream failures rather than synthesizing missing goldens.
component_oracle.checks: All 11 define_patch_characteristics outputs and all 6 Lcyl outputs; exact finite/NaN/infinity masks, existing flux atol 0.05 W/m2 and rtol 1e-5. Also verify unchanged first-sweep accumulators bitwise against the baseline in a diagnostic kernel.

worker_packet.chronological_oracle: tests/reference/small_original_cpu/boundaries via all 24 test_original_longwave_boundaries events, then all existing test_pipeline_reference cases. Compare carried state and all named outputs using existing rules; do not replace chronological execution with independently initialized timesteps.
additional_falsification: Threads serial/1/4/10 and block sizes 1,7,17,128,whole domain; dense and packed exact visibility layouts; all four existing patch options.

Hold moments fixed and vary Lup spatially, Ta, Tgwall, esky, ewall (including 0 and 1), solar position/day-night. Only geometry is reused. New original outputs must be generated in the isolated pinned upstream environment, never from candidate.
All-open/all-blocked/mixed/nonbinary visibility, positive/negative zero, NaN/Inf and high finite inputs must take a proven safe path or original fallback and retain existing mask semantics.
Repeat tile cache lifecycle and invalidation tests; inspect moment allocation, retained references, and cleanup after failure.
worker_packet.pipeline_gates: Full 153 patches, 24 chronological bands, all ten model fields, exact artifacts/metadata/masks, original intermediate/final gates including TMRT 0.01 K and UTCI 0.02 K. Required original dense and vegetation 1024 cases remain necessary for promotion. An existing unrelated parity failure remains a failure; do not blame or hide it. Linux MKL approval remains pending, so any separate diagnostic math profile must be labeled and held equal on both candidate sides.
worker_packet.performance_protocol: Create a new pre-execution protocol modeled on the existing paired persistent-JIT protocol, without editing it: immutable same-math-profile baseline and variant inventories, seed/order frozen, 5 pairs per small/256 x 1/4 threads x first-use/primed-JIT geometry-warm (40 pairs); every measured worker fresh chronology/output namespace. Include imports/JIT/moment construction/model/output in appropriate end-to-end interval. Preserve 20 ms process-tree RSS sampling, 12 GiB cap, all failures, subgroup invalidation, and source/fixture/harness provenance. Separate kernel construction/application timings only as diagnostics. Report ratio distributions and cold/warm tradeoff; reject if complete priority workload regresses under frozen acceptance rule. Do not derive an upstream speedup from candidate-pair data.
worker_packet.promotion: Require source and installed-wheel no-Torch validation plus existing cache collision regression after any accepted source change. No default integration solely from component or microbenchmark success. Stop with reviewable diff, raw evidence and failures; no P7/release completion claim.

alternative_compiled_extension.decision: Conditional defer: available profiles identify numerical work worth investigation, but do not yet justify Cython/C++ or an additional backend.

evidence.later_cache_matrix: reports/characterization/p7_persistent_jit_serial_variant/pairs_v1/summary.json: 40 pairs passed; measures candidate caching improvement, not residual native operation attribution.

limits: The warmed cProfile run still compiles in a fresh worker; it predates persistent-cache promotion and is not a pure steady-state measurement.
Native loop internals and the fraction spent in the second longwave sweep are not resolved. The full 2.485 seconds is not a predicted removable cost.
No evidence shows a Numba expressiveness or code-generation limit that a C++ port overcomes. Algebraic reuse is implementable in the present backend.
The later 40-pair cache result does not establish post-promotion hotspots or portable compiled-extension benefit.
alternative_compiled_extension.reconsider_when: Obtain signature-verified, fully warmed post-promotion full-pipeline attribution on small/256 and a valid representative 1024 case under a fixed approved math profile. Demonstrate a residual kernel bottleneck and why Numba cannot adequately express the improvement; specify stable array ABI, build portability, licensing/maintenance cost, same original oracle gates, and measured complete-workload advantage. This is an unmet condition, not an experimentally rejected extension or completion claim.

verification_performed: Read implementation and pinned oracle/test contracts; inspected retained profile and paired-summary evidence; evaluated one concrete float32 reassociation witness. No moment implementation, new numerical comparison, or performance benchmark was executed for this design.

isolated_conduit_review.decision: Approved bounded isolated integration with pre-freeze fixes; source/wheel/main promotion not authorized by this review.
isolated_conduit_review.ownership: Optional private reflection_moments field on GeometryCache, default None. Construct once per tile after finalized static visibility and exact Lcyl patch factors, before chronological loop. Existing tile ExitStack closes owner; no serialization or global state. Bundle references must be gone after tile function exits, including error paths.
isolated_conduit_review.forwarding: Explicit private _longwave_moments keyword through Solweig_2022a_calc, private bundled longwave dispatcher, compiled Lcyl and define, then serial/parallel kernels. Consume keyword before binding to original reference signature. Keep existing Lcyl public wrapper unchanged; None retains current execution. Optional private Solweig keyword changes introspection and is experimental pending final API review.
isolated_conduit_review.identity: Bind logical rows/cols, exact contents/order/dtypes, actual solid and angular factors, algorithm, numerical profile and source fingerprint. Restrict dense to float32 or hash its actual dtype. Validate coefficients in O(P) per call if needed; never rehash/rebuild O(NP) each timestep. Do not use TileMomentOwner.build per timestep, since current implementation constructs before checking cached identity.
isolated_conduit_review.immutability_fix: Current ndarray setflags(write=False) is reversible by a caller retaining owning array. Use immutable bytes-backed payload or a rigorously tested exclusive-ownership contract; prefer immutable backing. Account for temporary construction copy in peak RSS.
additional_tests: Same pixel count but different logical rows/cols invalidates identity
Two concurrent tile identities remain distinct
Success, injected construction failure and pipeline failure release all tile refs

performance_acceptance.ratio: variant end-to-end elapsed / baseline end-to-end elapsed
performance_acceptance.both_repeated256_geometry_warm_subgroups: Each median <= 0.970 and at least 4 of 5 paired ratios < 1.000
performance_acceptance.all_other_gates: Correctness, memory, artifact and provenance mandatory; any failed pair invalidates its subgroup and overall promotion eligibility. Unmet performance rule rejects/default promotion is inconclusive; no threshold changes after results.
performance_acceptance.interpretation: Predeclared engineering acceptance criterion, not statistical significance. Retain all raw ratios and ranges.
performance_acceptance.construction: Once per fresh measured worker, timed in both regimes; numerical-equivalent Numba builder optimization allowed before freeze. No per-step O(NP) key generation.

isolated_conduit_review.delivery: Actionable packet sent directly to cura_execution. Review performed by source inspection, not rerunning the worker checks.

blocking_findings: No executable angular paired harness found in tools; adapt existing JIT harness in a new isolated file and retain targeted tests/dry-run before review.
Integrated moment kernels do not implement the reviewed finite/range fallback; invalid-bundle fallback alone does not preserve nonfinite and overflow semantics.
validate_bundle does not validate supplied visibility sources, so another tile same shape/angles can use stale moments. Require immutable-source identity/token binding without per-step content hash.
Protocol says balanced order but repeated256 first-use n4 is variant-first all five times; pre-execution seeded within-subgroup 2/3 balance required.

integration_validation.json contains placeholder component command and summary-only source/wheel passes. No raw logs/JUnit/wheel retained under experiment directory. Locate actual external evidence or rerun correctness with durable commands/artifacts; historical cleanup does not authorize reconstructing logs.
Source/profile validation uses fixed strings; bind accepted math profile and frozen source inventory, and refresh stale protocol references to preliminary bundle/design versions.
positive_findings: Explicit once-before-chronology pipeline construction, GeometryCache field, private forwarding and owner.close registered on ExitStack are present.
Bundle ndarray uses immutable bytes backing.
Source manifest hashes matched inspected snapshot.
integrated_snapshot_review.reported_not_independently_verified: 18 component + 9 source + 9 installed and 8 builds/8 closes are reported in summary; not accepted as durable execution evidence yet.
integrated_snapshot_review.action: Sent actionable fixes and request for executable harness/durable correctness evidence directly to cura_execution. No timing launched.
